kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نأتلف (form VIII)
# نَأْتَلِفُ (naʔtalifu) /naʔ.ta.li.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# نَأْتَلِفَ (naʔtalifa) /naʔ.ta.li.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# نَأْتَلِفْ (naʔtalif) /naʔ.ta.lif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
